name: 37110 · Mcminnville, TN
findings: ZIP 37110 (Mcminnville) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37110 (Mcminnville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37110 (Mcminnville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
